title: 🎨 Palette: Improve accessibility for document Open buttons
body:
💡 What: Modified the generic "Open" button in the `ClientFactSheetModal.jsx` documents list to use a visually hidden screen-reader only `<span>` instead of an `aria-label`.

🎯 Why: Using `aria-label` on buttons that contain visible text overrides that visible text for screen readers. By using `aria-hidden="true"` on the visible "Open" text and providing a dedicated `.sr-only` span containing both the action and the specific file name, we preserve the visual design while giving screen reader users full context of which document they are about to open.

📸 Before/After: No visual changes.

♿ Accessibility: Ensures that screen reader users navigating a list of "Open" buttons understand exactly which file each button corresponds to without overriding the generic button text.
